# Eustace Crentsil

> Full-stack developer and technical project manager in Accra, Ghana. I work with clients in Ghana, the US and remotely worldwide.

## Services

- [Website & Web Application Development](https://eustacecrentsil.vercel.app/services/#web): business websites, web apps, online stores, portals and WordPress builds, with support after launch.
- [Business Automation](https://eustacecrentsil.vercel.app/services/#automation): tool integrations, lead handling, follow-ups and repetitive workflows.
- [Technical Project Management](https://eustacecrentsil.vercel.app/services/#pm): requirements, scope, planning, team coordination and quality assurance.

## Skills and stack

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, PHP, Python, Django, Node.js, MySQL and WordPress. Hosting and deployment with AWS and cPanel. Project tools include Asana, Trello, Notion, GitHub, Jira and Slack.

## Background

I co-founded Clottware, Inc. and worked there from October 2023 to December 2025. I have an MSc in Applied Geophysics from the University of Ghana and Front-End and Back-End certificates from ALX, March 2026.
